title: Prepare V2 requirements and overall design proposal
goal: Prepare nonnormative V2 requirements, change proposal, and overall architecture for human approval without finalizing detailed design
out_of_scope: Detailed design finalization before human overall-design approval
Product code, database migration implementation, AI, mobile, authentication, deployment
Active baseline and normative document registry changes
acceptance_criteria: Candidate requirements capture source groups, lightweight control plans, human assignment, configurable arrival-window overview, equipment changes, deliverable submission, and manual acceptance
Overall design preserves V1 operation and defines proposed additive data, desktop information architecture, migration safety, and explicit approval gates
All proposal files are visibly nonnormative and detailed design remains blocked pending explicit human overall-design approval

release_controls.rollback_plan: remove the local nonnormative proposal files
release_controls.observation_metrics: scenario traceability, design completeness, reviewer findings, proposal fingerprint, and Release governance results
release_controls.stop_conditions: scope ambiguity, detailed-design gate violation, active baseline mutation, or unresolved reviewer finding
